{{Quote|I don't recall an invitation to play Questions Three with you, Syndic.|Mara Jade, posing as Celina Marniss|<ref name="FC" />}}
'''Questions Three''' was a common verbal game played by children throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], similar to [[Question the Quarren]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|63|Question the Quarren; Questions Three}}</ref> While posing as a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named Celina Marniss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] stopped [[Talon Karrde]]&mdash;posing as [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] Pandis Hart of the [[Sif-Uwana Council]]&mdash;from questioning her further by mentioning the game.<ref name="FC" />
